notes.title: TEAM SIX - Aromred Troops. Gamepad Support
notes.content:
Ver 1.3.05 Update note.

- In Team Six games, you can now play using an Xbox game controller.
- You can adjust the sensitivity of the analog sticks for both gameplay and UI.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44272469/3462513017c7a0805fe5909fc428f000526dd6a9.png


- The Unit's ability display error has been fixed.
- The weapon AIM and RELOAD values have been adjusted.
- Mission 12, 17 bug fixed.
- Volunteer bug fixed.
